entities.summary: Stonebwoy (b. 1988-03-05, Ashaiman) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ashaiman and Ghana. Known in the fields of ghana, composers & musicians, africa.
